function.arguments: {"command":"cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && sed -n '1,200p' build.sh && cd zstd && make -C tests/fuzz simple_decompress -j2"}
function.name: execute_bash

content:
cd tests/fuzz
make -j seedcorpora
./fuzz.py build all
for target in $(./fuzz.py list); do
    cp "$target" "$OUT"
    options=default.options
    if [ -f "$target.options" ]; then
        options="$target.options"
    fi
    cp "$options" "$OUT/$target.options"
    if [ -f "$target.dict" ]; then
        cp "$target.dict" "$OUT"
    fi
    cp "corpora/${target}_seed_corpus.zip" "$OUT"
done
